Name: Transform Trash when Fishing
Author: daitsuku
Description:
[b]Feature:[/b]
[list]
[*]If you're fishing and get trashes, the trash transform into a fish according to where you're currently at.
[/list][b]Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]Download the Mod:[/b] Place the [u][b]﻿NoTrashFishing[/b][/u] folder into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.
[*][b]Optional but recommended:[/b] Install Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game configuration.
[/list][b]Config:[/b]
[list]
[*]Using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] (recommended)
[*]edit config.json in mod folder﻿
[/list]
[b]Mod used in screenshot:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21433]Vanilla Tweaks - Aquarium Edition[/url]
[/list]
[b]Remark:
[list]
[*]I make and use this mod for a long time but keep it private for a while, and i think that someone may (or may not idk) want to use this mod too.
[*]You can held a fishing rod and then drop trash, and the mod works as you're fishing and get trash.
[*](iirc)I didn't write a loop for a stack of trash items, so if you try to throw a stack of trash then pick it up while holding a fishing rod. it is going to give you only 1 fish.
[*]This mod is not intend to make to public in the first place. so, bugs / bug reports will be look at from time to time. Please do not rush me to fix the mod.
[*]Feature request will be update from time to time as well (if it is a good idea to me). Do not gets you hopes up that much.
[/list][size=4][url=https://patreon.com/daitsuku]💖 Support me on Patreon
